# ChorusSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("ChorusSoundEffect")`

A copy of the sound that drifts a little out of time and tune with it: one voice as several, a shimmer.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Depth` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How far it drifts, 0 to 1. |
| `Mix` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How much of what is heard is the copy, 0 to 1. |
| `Rate` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How fast the copy drifts back and forth, in hertz. |
